description: This file defines the MenuStringRenderer interface, which declares methods for rendering various components of a menu in the OFBiz widget framework. It specifies contract methods for rendering menu items, opening and closing menus, formatting wrappers, links, and images, with parameters for output writing, context, and model objects.

methods.name: renderMenuItem
methods.description: Renders a menu item using the provided Appendable writer, context map, and ModelMenuItem object.

methods.name: renderMenuOpen
methods.description: Renders the opening of a menu with the provided writer, context, and ModelMenu.

methods.name: renderMenuClose
methods.description: Renders the closing of a menu with the provided writer, context, and ModelMenu.

methods.name: renderFormatSimpleWrapperOpen
methods.description: Renders the opening of a simple wrapper format for a menu.

methods.name: renderFormatSimpleWrapperClose
methods.description: Renders the closing of a simple wrapper format for a menu.

methods.name: renderFormatSimpleWrapperRows
methods.description: Renders the rows within a simple wrapper format for a menu.

methods.name: renderLink
methods.description: Renders a link for a menu item.

methods.name: renderImage
methods.description: Renders an image within the menu context.
